explanation: Adds studyRecord.test.ts, which pins the study publication record at its interface: a PMID named only in the citation, the source record's only linked PMID, empty DOIs, DOI-only and case-insensitive DOI matches, https-only links, the default contrast and labels, and per-track arm counts. seoPages.test.ts drops its identity cases and keeps layout; seoStudyContent.test.ts passes a record instead of raw meta.
